text: Good evening. My granddaughter Rosie is 9 and staying with me. She has a temperature of 38.2 and a streaming nose, lots of sneezing. She won't settle to sleep tonight but is otherwise fine in herself. I did get a fright earlier when I saw purple marks on her legs, but it turned out she'd been drawing on herself with felt tips, it came straight off with a flannel. Can she have some paracetamol and is there anything else I should do.
